reason: The plugin configures DeepSeek Harness on Windows to expose Git Bash as the sole terminal, disable PowerShell, and install bash-only presets. Human review is warranted because the README states that Windows defaults to danger-full-access with approvals set to never.

summaries.zh: 将 Windows 上的 DeepSeek Harness 配置为仅使用 Git Bash 终端，并安装 bash-only 会话预设。
summaries.en: Configures DeepSeek Harness on Windows to use Git Bash as its only terminal and installs bash-only session presets.

capabilities: Forces DeepSeek Harness to use Git Bash as the only terminal on Windows
Installs derived agent presets through junctions
Enables Windows sandbox danger-full-access with approvals disabled by default
